source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
    convert(date,[TRAN_DATE]) AS TRAN_DATE
    ,[TRAN_ID]
    ,[PART_TRAN_SRI_NUM]
    ,[BANK_ID]
    ,[DEL_FLG]
    ,[TRAN_TYPE]
    ,[TRAN_SUB_TYPE]
    ,[PART_TRAN_TYPE]
    ,[GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE]
    ,[ACID]
    ,convert(date,[VAIUE_DATE]) AS [VAIUE_DATE]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS [TRAN_AMT]
    ,[TRAN_PARTICUIAR]
    ,[ENTRY_USER_ID]
    ,[PSTD_USER_ID]
    ,[VFD_USER_ID]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(ENTRY_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS [ENTRY_DATE]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(PSTD_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS [PSTD_DATE]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(VFD_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS [VFD_DATE]
    ,[RPT_CODE]
    ,[REF_NUM]
    ,[INSTRMNT_TYPE]
    ,convert(date,[INSTRMNT_DATE]) AS [INSTRMNT_DATE]
    ,[INSTRMNT_NUM]
    ,[INSTRMNT_AIPHA]
    ,[TRAN_RMKS]
    ,[PSTD_FIG]
    ,[PRNT_ADVC_IND]
    ,[AMT_RESERVATION_IND]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([RESERVATION_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS [RESERVATION_AMT]
    ,[RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND]
    ,[LCHG_USER_ID]
    ,[CHG_TIME]
    ,[RCRE_USER_ID]
    ,[RCRE_TIME]
    ,[CUST_ID]
    ,[VOUCHER_PRINT_FIG]
    ,[MODUIE_ID]
    ,[BR_CODE]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FX_TRAN_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS [FX_TRAN_AMT]
    ,[RATE_CODE]
    ,convert(numeric(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS [RATE]
    ,[CMCY_CODE]
    ,[NAVIGATION_FIG]
    ,[TRAN_CRNCY_CODE]
    ,[REF_CRNCY_CODE]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([REF_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS [REF_AMT]
    ,[SOI_ID]
    ,[BANK_CODE]
    ,[TREA_REF_NUM]
    ,convert(numeric(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TREA_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS [TREA_RATE]
    ,[TS_CNT]
    ,[GST_UPD_FIG]
    ,[SO_FIG]
    ,[EABFAB_UPD_FLG]
    ,[IFT_LIEN_FIG]
    ,[PROXY_POST_IND]
    ,[SL_SRI_NUM]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(SL_ORG_EXEC_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS [SL_ORG_EXEC_DATE]
    ,[PR_SRI_NUM]
    ,[SERIAI_NUM]
    ,[DEI_MEMO_PAD]
    ,[UAD_MODULE_ID]
    ,[UAD_MODUIE_KEY]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(REVERSAI_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS [REVERSAI_DATE]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(REVERSAI_VAIUE_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS [REVERSAI_VAIUE_DATE]
    ,[PTTM_EVENT_TYPE]
    ,[PROXY_ACID]
    ,[TOD_ENTITY_TYPE]
    ,[TOD_ENTITY_ID]
    ,[DTH_INIT_SOI_ID]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([REGUIARIZATION_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS [REGUIARIZATION_AMT]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PRINCIPAI_PORTION_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS [PRINCIPAI_PORTION_AMT]
    ,[TF_ENTITY_SOI_ID]
    ,[TRAN_PARTICUIAR_2]
    ,[TRAN_PARTICUIAR_CODE]
    ,[TR_STATUS]
    ,[SVS_TRAN_ID]
    ,[CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FIG]
    ,[REFERRAL_ID]
    ,[PARTY_CODE]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(GI_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS [GI_DATE]
    ,[BKDT_TRAN_FLG]
    ,[MPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FI]
    ,[PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FIG]
    ,[MUD_POOI_BAI_BUILD_FIG]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([USED_CIEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM],' ',''),''),0)) AS [USED_CIEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([USED_SINGIE_TRAN_IIM],' ',''),''),0)) AS [USED_SINGIE_TRAN_IIM]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([USED_UN_CIR_OVER_DACC_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS [USED_UN_CIR_OVER_DACC_AMT]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([USED_CIEAN_EMER_ADVN],' ',''),''),0)) AS [USED_CIEAN_EMER_ADVN]
    ,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([USED_EMER_ADVN],' ',''),''),0)) AS [USED_EMER_ADVN]
    ,[GI_SEGMENT_STRING]
    ,[COMB_TRAN_ID]
    ,[SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE]
    ,[USER_PART_TRAN_CODE]
    ,[TRAN_FREE_CODE1]
    ,[TRAN_FREE_CODE2]
    ,[RESP_ACCT_REF_NO]
    ,[PURPOSE_CODE]
    ,1 as isActive
    ,0 as isLatest
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(date,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM [d360].[STG_GLD_TRANDETAIL]
WHERE H = 'D'
